episodes.rationale: For Marigold, you can distribute the cue sheet only after Tavi approves the silent cue. For Marigold, permission to distribute the cue sheet also requires that the rehearsal log contains a full run. Both conditions for permission to distribute the cue sheet in Marigold are necessary because partial rehearsals omit the entrance transition.
